name: Waiver approved by a second person lowers what is owed and the ledger balances
title: SC-11-10-01 Waiver approved by a second person lowers what is owed and the ledger balances
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a waiver requested by one manager
When a second person approves it
Then what is owed drops and the ledger still balances
